source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
During [your opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), as an attack targets a **DEATH GUARD** unit of yours up to 6" from this model, you can activate this ability. If you do, once the attacking unit finishes its attacks, the targeted unit can shoot as though in [your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), but:

- the **BS** of its attacks is worsened by 1
- it can target only the attacking unit, and only while that unit is an eligible target

trigger.event: attack targets friendly DEATH GUARD unit
